news.title: ECE's Badesha appointed as President's Fellow
news.summary_en: Santokh Badesha, Distinguished Professor in the Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, has been appointed as a President's Fellow in recognition of his numerous and continued professional accomplishments in idea generation, management and protection of intellectual property.

news.title: Purdue hosts national IoT4Ag retreat focused on the future of precision agriculture
news.summary_en: Purdue University welcomed university researchers, students, industry leaders and the grower community to the 2026 Annual Retreat of the Internet of Things for Precision Agriculture (IoT4Ag) from May 19-21 at the Beck Agricultural Center in West Lafayette and at regional farms in Indiana.
